# CMakeLists.txt for ap2 v0.1.0
# Generated by cforge - C++ project management tool

cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.15)

# Project configuration
project(ap2 VERSION 0.1.0 LANGUAGES C CXX )

# Include compiler's implicit include directories in compile_commands.json
# This helps clangd and other tools find standard library headers
if(CMAKE_EXPORT_COMPILE_COMMANDS)
  set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_INCLUDE_DIRECTORIES ${CMAKE_CXX_IMPLICIT_INCLUDE_DIRECTORIES})
endif()

# Set source directory
set(SOURCE_DIR "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}")

# Project description
set(PROJECT_DESCRIPTION "Application Primitives — a C17 kit for games and tools")
set(PROJECT_AUTHOR "Jack Waechter")

string(TOUPPER ${PROJECT_NAME} PROJECT_NAME_UPPER)
# Set C++ standard
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 17)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
set(CMAKE_CXX_EXTENSIONS OFF)

# Set C standard
set(CMAKE_C_STANDARD 17)
set(CMAKE_C_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
set(CMAKE_C_EXTENSIONS OFF)

# platform detection
if(WIN32)
    set(CFORGE_PLATFORM "windows")
elseif(APPLE)
    set(CFORGE_PLATFORM "macos")
else()
    set(CFORGE_PLATFORM "linux")
endif()

# compiler detection
if(MSVC AND NOT CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER_ID STREQUAL "Clang")
    set(CFORGE_COMPILER "msvc")
elseif(MINGW)
    set(CFORGE_COMPILER "mingw")
elseif(CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER_ID STREQUAL "Clang")
    if(APPLE)
        set(CFORGE_COMPILER "apple_clang")
    else()
        set(CFORGE_COMPILER "clang")
    endif()
elseif(CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER_ID STREQUAL "GNU")
    set(CFORGE_COMPILER "gcc")
else()
    set(CFORGE_COMPILER "unknown")
endif()
message(STATUS "platform: ${CFORGE_PLATFORM}, compiler: ${CFORGE_COMPILER}")

# CMake options
set(CMAKE_EXPORT_COMPILE_COMMANDS ON)
set(CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER "C:/msys64/ucrt64/bin/g++.exe")
set(CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER_WORKS "TRUE")
set(CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS "-B C:/msys64/ucrt64/bin")
set(CMAKE_C_COMPILER "C:/msys64/ucrt64/bin/gcc.exe")
set(CMAKE_C_COMPILER_WORKS "TRUE")
set(CMAKE_C_FLAGS "-B C:/msys64/ucrt64/bin")
set(CMAKE_DEPENDS_USE_COMPILER "FALSE")
set(CMAKE_NINJA_FORCE_RESPONSE_FILE "ON")

# Build configurations
if(NOT CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE)
    set(CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE "Debug")
endif()

message(STATUS "Building with ${CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE} configuration")

# Configure output directories
if(DEFINED CMAKE_CONFIGURATION_TYPES)
  foreach(cfg IN LISTS CMAKE_CONFIGURATION_TYPES)
    string(TOUPPER ${cfg} CFG_UPPER)
    set(CMAKE_ARCHIVE_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY_${CFG_UPPER} "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/lib/${cfg}")
    set(CMAKE_LIBRARY_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY_${CFG_UPPER} "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/lib/${cfg}")
    set(CMAKE_RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY_${CFG_UPPER} "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/bin/${cfg}")
  endforeach()
else()
  set(CMAKE_ARCHIVE_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/lib/${CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE}")
  set(CMAKE_LIBRARY_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/lib/${CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE}")
  set(CMAKE_RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/bin/${CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE}")
endif()

# Index dependencies via FetchContent
include(FetchContent)

# glad v2.0.8
FetchContent_Declare(
    glad
    GIT_REPOSITORY https://github.com/Dav1dde/glad.git
    GIT_TAG v2.0.8
    GIT_SHALLOW TRUE
)

# glfw v3.5.1
FetchContent_Declare(
    glfw
    GIT_REPOSITORY https://github.com/glfw/glfw.git
    GIT_TAG 3.5.1
    GIT_SHALLOW TRUE
)

# Fetch packages without setup commands
FetchContent_MakeAvailable(glfw)

# Handle glad with setup commands
FetchContent_GetProperties(glad)
if(NOT glad_POPULATED)
  FetchContent_Populate(glad)
  set(_glad_setup_needed FALSE)
  if(NOT EXISTS "${glad_SOURCE_DIR}/generated/include/glad/gl.h")
    set(_glad_setup_needed TRUE)
  endif()
  if(NOT EXISTS "${glad_SOURCE_DIR}/generated/src/gl.c")
    set(_glad_setup_needed TRUE)
  endif()
  if(NOT EXISTS "${glad_SOURCE_DIR}/generated/CMakeLists.txt")
    set(_glad_setup_needed TRUE)
  endif()
  if(_glad_setup_needed)
  if(WIN32)
    execute_process(
      COMMAND python -m pip install glad2 --quiet --break-system-packages
      WORKING_DIRECTORY "${glad_SOURCE_DIR}"
      RESULT_VARIABLE _setup_result
      OUTPUT_VARIABLE _setup_output
      ERROR_VARIABLE _setup_error
    )
    if(NOT _setup_result EQUAL 0)
      message(FATAL_ERROR "Setup failed for glad: ${_setup_result}\nOutput: ${_setup_output}\nError: ${_setup_error}")
    endif()
    execute_process(
      COMMAND python -m glad --api gl:core=4.6 --out-path ${glad_SOURCE_DIR}/generated c --loader
      WORKING_DIRECTORY "${glad_SOURCE_DIR}"
      RESULT_VARIABLE _setup_result
      OUTPUT_VARIABLE _setup_output
      ERROR_VARIABLE _setup_error
    )
    if(NOT _setup_result EQUAL 0)
      message(FATAL_ERROR "Setup failed for glad: ${_setup_result}\nOutput: ${_setup_output}\nError: ${_setup_error}")
    endif()
    execute_process(
      COMMAND python -c "import os;N=chr(10);os.makedirs('${glad_SOURCE_DIR}/generated',exist_ok=True);open('${glad_SOURCE_DIR}/generated/CMakeLists.txt','w').write(N.join(['cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.10)','project(glad C)','add_library(glad STATIC src/gl.c)','target_include_directories(glad PUBLIC '+'$'+'{CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/include)','target_link_libraries(glad PUBLIC '+'$'+'{CMAKE_DL_LIBS})','']))"
      WORKING_DIRECTORY "${glad_SOURCE_DIR}"
      RESULT_VARIABLE _setup_result
      OUTPUT_VARIABLE _setup_output
      ERROR_VARIABLE _setup_error
    )
    if(NOT _setup_result EQUAL 0)
      message(FATAL_ERROR "Setup failed for glad: ${_setup_result}\nOutput: ${_setup_output}\nError: ${_setup_error}")
    endif()
  elseif(APPLE)
    execute_process(
      COMMAND python3 -m pip install glad2 --quiet --break-system-packages
      WORKING_DIRECTORY "${glad_SOURCE_DIR}"
      RESULT_VARIABLE _setup_result
      OUTPUT_VARIABLE _setup_output
      ERROR_VARIABLE _setup_error
    )
    if(NOT _setup_result EQUAL 0)
      message(FATAL_ERROR "Setup failed for glad: ${_setup_result}\nOutput: ${_setup_output}\nError: ${_setup_error}")
    endif()
    execute_process(
      COMMAND python3 -m glad --api gl:core=4.6 --out-path ${glad_SOURCE_DIR}/generated c --loader
      WORKING_DIRECTORY "${glad_SOURCE_DIR}"
      RESULT_VARIABLE _setup_result
      OUTPUT_VARIABLE _setup_output
      ERROR_VARIABLE _setup_error
    )
    if(NOT _setup_result EQUAL 0)
      message(FATAL_ERROR "Setup failed for glad: ${_setup_result}\nOutput: ${_setup_output}\nError: ${_setup_error}")
    endif()
    execute_process(
      COMMAND sh -c 'cat > ${glad_SOURCE_DIR}/generated/CMakeLists.txt << EOF
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.10)
project(glad C)
add_library(glad STATIC src/gl.c)
target_include_directories(glad PUBLIC \${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/include)
target_link_libraries(glad PUBLIC \${CMAKE_DL_LIBS})
EOF'
      WORKING_DIRECTORY "${glad_SOURCE_DIR}"
      RESULT_VARIABLE _setup_result
      OUTPUT_VARIABLE _setup_output
      ERROR_VARIABLE _setup_error
    )
    if(NOT _setup_result EQUAL 0)
      message(FATAL_ERROR "Setup failed for glad: ${_setup_result}\nOutput: ${_setup_output}\nError: ${_setup_error}")
    endif()
  else()
    execute_process(
      COMMAND python3 -m pip install glad2 --quiet --break-system-packages
      WORKING_DIRECTORY "${glad_SOURCE_DIR}"
      RESULT_VARIABLE _setup_result
      OUTPUT_VARIABLE _setup_output
      ERROR_VARIABLE _setup_error
    )
    if(NOT _setup_result EQUAL 0)
      message(FATAL_ERROR "Setup failed for glad: ${_setup_result}\nOutput: ${_setup_output}\nError: ${_setup_error}")
    endif()
    execute_process(
      COMMAND python3 -m glad --api gl:core=4.6 --out-path ${glad_SOURCE_DIR}/generated c --loader
      WORKING_DIRECTORY "${glad_SOURCE_DIR}"
      RESULT_VARIABLE _setup_result
      OUTPUT_VARIABLE _setup_output
      ERROR_VARIABLE _setup_error
    )
    if(NOT _setup_result EQUAL 0)
      message(FATAL_ERROR "Setup failed for glad: ${_setup_result}\nOutput: ${_setup_output}\nError: ${_setup_error}")
    endif()
    execute_process(
      COMMAND sh -c 'cat > ${glad_SOURCE_DIR}/generated/CMakeLists.txt << EOF
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.10)
project(glad C)
add_library(glad STATIC src/gl.c)
target_include_directories(glad PUBLIC \${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/include)
target_link_libraries(glad PUBLIC \${CMAKE_DL_LIBS})
EOF'
      WORKING_DIRECTORY "${glad_SOURCE_DIR}"
      RESULT_VARIABLE _setup_result
      OUTPUT_VARIABLE _setup_output
      ERROR_VARIABLE _setup_error
    )
    if(NOT _setup_result EQUAL 0)
      message(FATAL_ERROR "Setup failed for glad: ${_setup_result}\nOutput: ${_setup_output}\nError: ${_setup_error}")
    endif()
  endif()
  endif()
  add_subdirectory("${glad_SOURCE_DIR}/generated" "${glad_BINARY_DIR}")
endif()

# Add source files
file(GLOB_RECURSE SOURCES
    "${SOURCE_DIR}/src/*.cpp"
    "${SOURCE_DIR}/src/*.c"
    "${SOURCE_DIR}/src/core/*.cpp"
    "${SOURCE_DIR}/src/core/*.c"
)

# Custom CMake code (inject_before_target)
set(AP2_APP_TARGET ap2_app)
set(PROJECT_NAME "${AP2_APP_TARGET}")


# Add target
add_executable(${PROJECT_NAME} ${SOURCES})

# Custom CMake code (inject_after_target)
cmake_language(DEFER CALL include "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/cmake/ap2-product.cmake")


# Version definitions (from cforge.toml)
target_compile_definitions(${PROJECT_NAME} PUBLIC
    ${PROJECT_NAME_UPPER}_VERSION="${PROJECT_VERSION}"
    ${PROJECT_NAME_UPPER}_VERSION_MAJOR=${PROJECT_VERSION_MAJOR}
    ${PROJECT_NAME_UPPER}_VERSION_MINOR=${PROJECT_VERSION_MINOR}
    ${PROJECT_NAME_UPPER}_VERSION_PATCH=${PROJECT_VERSION_PATCH}
    PROJECT_VERSION="${PROJECT_VERSION}"
    PROJECT_VERSION_MAJOR=${PROJECT_VERSION_MAJOR}
    PROJECT_VERSION_MINOR=${PROJECT_VERSION_MINOR}
    PROJECT_VERSION_PATCH=${PROJECT_VERSION_PATCH}
)

# Include directories
target_include_directories(${PROJECT_NAME} PUBLIC
    "${SOURCE_DIR}/include"
    "${SOURCE_DIR}/include/AP2"
    "${SOURCE_DIR}/third_party/stb"

)

# Link FetchContent dependencies

    glad
    glfw

# Portable compiler flags per configuration
# Debug configuration flags
if(CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE STREQUAL "Debug")
    # Portable compiler flags
    if(MSVC AND NOT CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER_ID STREQUAL "Clang")
        target_compile_options(${PROJECT_NAME} PRIVATE /W4 /Zi /EHsc /GR)
    elseif(CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER_ID STREQUAL "GNU")
        target_compile_options(${PROJECT_NAME} PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra -g -fdiagnostics-color=always)
    elseif(CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER_ID MATCHES "Clang")
        target_compile_options(${PROJECT_NAME} PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra -g -fcolor-diagnostics)
    endif()
endif()

# Release configuration flags
if(CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE STREQUAL "Release")
    # Portable compiler flags
    if(MSVC AND NOT CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER_ID STREQUAL "Clang")
        target_compile_options(${PROJECT_NAME} PRIVATE /O2 /W4 /GL /EHsc /GR)
        target_link_options(${PROJECT_NAME} PRIVATE /LTCG)
    elseif(CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER_ID STREQUAL "GNU")
        target_compile_options(${PROJECT_NAME} PRIVATE -O2 -Wall -Wextra -flto -fdiagnostics-color=always)
        target_link_options(${PROJECT_NAME} PRIVATE -flto)
    elseif(CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER_ID MATCHES "Clang")
        target_compile_options(${PROJECT_NAME} PRIVATE -O2 -Wall -Wextra -flto -fcolor-diagnostics)
        target_link_options(${PROJECT_NAME} PRIVATE -flto)
    endif()
endif()

# Relwithdebinfo configuration flags
if(CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE STREQUAL "Relwithdebinfo")
    # Portable compiler flags
    if(MSVC AND NOT CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER_ID STREQUAL "Clang")
        target_compile_options(${PROJECT_NAME} PRIVATE /O2 /W4 /Zi /EHsc /GR)
    elseif(CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER_ID STREQUAL "GNU")
        target_compile_options(${PROJECT_NAME} PRIVATE -O2 -Wall -Wextra -g -fdiagnostics-color=always)
    elseif(CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER_ID MATCHES "Clang")
        target_compile_options(${PROJECT_NAME} PRIVATE -O2 -Wall -Wextra -g -fcolor-diagnostics)
    endif()
endif()

# Minsizerel configuration flags
if(CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE STREQUAL "Minsizerel")

    if(MSVC AND NOT CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER_ID STREQUAL "Clang")
        target_compile_options(${PROJECT_NAME} PRIVATE /O1 /Os /W4 /EHsc /GR)
    elseif(CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER_ID STREQUAL "GNU")

    elseif(CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER_ID STREQUAL "GNU")

    set(CPACK_GENERATOR "ZIP;NSIS")
    set(CPACK_NSIS_MODIFY_PATH ON)
    set(CPACK_NSIS_ENABLE_UNINSTALL_BEFORE_INSTALL ON)
    set(CPACK_NSIS_PACKAGE_NAME "${PROJECT_NAME}")
